request.deadline: 18-month funding period with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Q3 2026: establish or host the not-for-profit entity, publish transition architecture and migration plan, and launch a public usage dashboard
Q4 2026: hold board election via on-chain voting under published rules and seat the elected board
Q1 2027: serve all public API traffic from the new stack, legally transfer Blockfrost IP, and maintain current service performance
Q2-Q3 2027: open public sustainability consultation and publish the chosen direction
2027: operate the public API at minimum 99% monthly uptime and publish quarterly technical and budget reports
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition under Intersect-administered treasury governance; final not-for-profit entity or host organization not yet determined in document
request.what: Fund an 18-month transition of Blockfrost into a free, community-governed not-for-profit public API, including operations, governance setup, service transition, and sustainability planning.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is the number-one hosted platform used by Cardano developers and grew from 39.3% survey usage in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025.
Blockfrost served 781,000 unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
In most Cardano epochs, more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
More than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.
The proposal would transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets into community stewardship under an independent community-governed not-for-profit.
The not-for-profit would provide an open, free public API for Cardano mainnet, preview, and preprod networks in their current format.
The requested budget is 9,832,979 ADA, calculated as $1,868,266 at $0.19 per ADA, with 79.1% for staffing, 19.3% for operations and infrastructure, and 1.6% for legal and accounting.
Any unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury, and quarterly reports will include technical data and a budget summary.

Long-term sustainability may come from paid commercial tiers or a vendor-backed not-for-profit model, with future profits or fees supporting the free public API and potentially flowing back to the Cardano Treasury.

Project delivery will be governed by an off-chain legal contract, Intersect delivery assurance, milestone acceptance, third-party assurance, and treasury smart contract administration with external oversight.

summary: The proposal requests 9,832,979 ADA for an 18-month transition of Blockfrost from commercial infrastructure into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, citing high developer adoption and transaction submission reliance, with milestones for entity formation, board election, service migration, IP transfer, sustained operations, and future sustainability planning.
